about.title: 私について / About
about.paragraph1: With over 2 years of experience in software development, I specialize in building scalable and efficient solutions using the PEAN stack (PostgreSQL, Express, Angular, Node.js). My approach emphasizes well-structured architectures, such as hexagonal design, to ensure maintainability and flexibility. I strive for clean, modular code while balancing technical excellence with practical, real-world application.
about.paragraph2: I believe in the Japanese concept of 'Kaizen' (改善) - continuous improvement. Each project is an opportunity to refine my craft and expand my knowledge.
about.paragraph3: My development philosophy is inspired by 'Wabi-sabi' (侘寂) - finding beauty in imperfection and accepting the natural cycle of growth and decay. This translates to creating software that is both beautiful and practical, embracing simplicity and authenticity.
about.quote: The best code is like a Japanese garden – carefully crafted, balanced, and appears simple despite the complex thought behind it.
